Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers checking in at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was fixed. The same note has a follow-up item to archive the Eau Claire kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea filed it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it went to tier-2 support for firmware testing.

What I left out:
- Moss's 2025-09-14 pipeline digest and 2026-03-23 renewal note both cover Quarrendon but give no ticket numbers.
- #4409, #4412 and FR-882 appear in Moss's Central notes, but they belong to Marrow Fieldworks and Marrow Agrisupply.
- Marcus's note is about Quarendon Freightways, which is a different company and not a customer.

I only searched the notes Moss saved as files (team digests). I didn't go through Slack messages.
